name: Dazing Bash (Combat)
body:
You can daze an opponent with a sudden strike from your shield.

Prerequisite(s): Improved Shield Bash, Shield Focus, base attack bonus +6.

Benefit(s): As a full round action or at the end of a charge you may make a special shield bash. If you deal damage, the target must make a Fortitude save DC equal to 10 + 1/2 your character level + your Strength modifier or be dazed until the beginning of your next turn.
